slots.value: The minimum time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceeds faster than normal
The most likely time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceeds as normal
The maximum time required to complete the task. Assumes that everything proceed slower than normal
The formula for calculating the mean or expected time is: Duration - (O+4M+P)/6
The ES is the maximum EF of all predecessors, except for the first task where the ES=0
The formula for calculating the Early finish time is: (EF=ES+Duration)
The LF time ts the minimum LS of all the successors, except for the last task where LF equals EF
The formula for calculating the Late start time is: (LS=LF-Duration)
The Slack time is calculated as LF minus EF. It can also be calculated as LS-ES. If the slack is “0”, then the task is on the critical path.
